step-1.text: Stand one side panel on its edge, holes facing in. Butt the bottom board against it and drive two screws through the side into the board. Snug, not stripped.

count-1.text: This step uses 1 side panel, 1 top and bottom and 2 screws.

step-2.text: Screw the two long shelves to the same side, two screws each. The holes set the cubby height, so just follow them.

count-2.text: This step uses 2 long shelves and 4 screws.

step-3.text: Tap a dowel into each divider hole, then press the twelve short dividers in between the boards, four per row. Push each one fully home so the cubbies stay square.

count-3.text: This step uses 12 dividers and 12 wood dowels.

step-4.text: Set the top board over the last row of dividers and screw it to the side panel.

count-4.text: This step uses 1 top and bottom and 2 screws.

step-5.text: With a helper steadying it, line the second side up with every board end and screw it on, top to bottom. Then check each cubby is square before the screws bite.

count-5.text: This step uses 1 side panel and 8 screws.

step-6.text: Set it on a flat floor and press on each top corner. If it rocks, check the screws again. Fill the low cubbies with the heavy things.

count-6.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

done.text: Done. Your SLEEKLINE 15-cubby storage 3×5 is built. Give it a proud little pat.
